prompts.name: flower
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE refined illustration asset for a Chinese Maliu embroidery cultural website, part of a matching three-piece collection. Square canvas, actual transparent background. Elegant restrained Chinese editorial illustration, predominantly flat shapes with very slight gradients, delicate fine parallel stitch marks, soft matte paper-like surfaces, uniform coloring, crisp graceful silhouettes, no glossy 3D render and no photographic realism. Exact shared palette: muted sage green #648d76, deep jade #366750, soft coral #ee947e, pale apricot #efd1a3, ivory #faf4e7. Small muted gold accents only. Isolated centered composition within the central 80% of the square, generous empty transparent margins, full uncropped subject. Sophisticated handmade aesthetic inspired by Maliu counted-thread geometric embroidery and stylized flower and butterfly motifs, clear symmetry and rhythmic small stitches. No words, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no cloud medallion, no solid colored background. Subject: a graceful upright flowering branch, one large coral-and-apricot eight-petal geometric flower with a small jade and ochre diamond center; two small subordinate buds and balanced sage green leaves. The flower is clearly crafted from fine even diagonal embroidery stitches, subtle textile texture with beautifully organized stitch directions. Botanical yet geometrically stylized, balanced airy negative spaces, clean slightly curved stems, no fabric square and no hoop.
